subject: System Design
title: Percentile Latencies
description: A micro-lesson that makes Percentile Latencies usable.

hook.text: Your average response time is 200ms. But 1% of users wait 5 seconds. The average hides the pain.

buildup.text: Percentiles show the distribution: p50 is the median, p99 is the slowest 1% of requests.

discovery.text: Amazon found that every 100ms of p99 latency costs them 1% in sales. Tail latency matters.

twist.text: The slowest requests often come from your best customers — those with the most data and activity.

climax.text: Averages lie. Percentiles reveal the real user experience, especially at the tail.

punchline.text: Don't trust averages — measure the p99.

quiz.question: What does p99 latency measure?
options: The response time that 99% of requests are faster than
